revision: v3: extra_bytes and missing_bytes gated separately; zero_extra_pass removed

definition.gate: R61 frozen-criterion dev probe: does the object-edge argmax predict content failure on unseen stems

held_constant.base_fixture: dev[0], as in R59 group B and R60
held_constant.goal: 让古旧木制器具到旧年石砌场所。
held_constant.template: 2-hop 把{object}放到{place}; records written as {desc}是{name}。 and {desc}对应{name}。

new_stems.family_shape: nested prefix family: the 6/9/12/15 B names are the first 2/3/4/5 characters of one 5-character stem

glyph_family.pool: 甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥
glyph_family.deal: order the pool by sha256(seed + character); stem i takes ordered[(i*5+k) % len(pool)] for k in 0..4

real_family.deal: order each list by sha256(seed + item); stem i = materials[i] + objects[i] + suffixes[i] (1+2+2 characters)

new_stems.selection_rule: deterministic hash deal declared before the run; no stem is chosen on its reading
new_stems.collision_rule: a generated 15 B name equal to either R60 stem name is a freeze-time error

replication.on_mismatch: engineering_failure; the prediction is not interpreted

error_names.type1: predicted failure but the answer is byte exact
error_names.type2: predicted pass but the answer is not byte exact

measurements.extra_bytes: max(0, answer_bytes - expected_bytes): bytes the answer emitted past the declared end
measurements.missing_bytes: max(0, expected_bytes - answer_bytes): declared bytes the answer never emitted
measurements.legacy_zero_extra: kept per cell only because the R60 anchor compares it; it is not a gate in this revision
measurements.early_eos_rule: a premature EOS only ever produces missing_bytes; it is never counted as an exception inside a zero-extra pass

old_reading.trigger: the v1/v2 run reported a single zero_extra gate; its 55/56 reading counted the early EOS of g1@15B as an exception inside a pass, not as a missing byte

recalibration.rule: every declared old reading must be reproduced by the v3 run; a mismatch is reported in recalibration.unchanged instead of being silently overwritten
recalibration.removal_reason: the old gate required len(raw) == stop and terminated, which is False on g1@15B while zero_extra_bytes_pass is True there; aliasing it would silently change the old reading, so it is removed and the migration is reported

baselines.constant_pass: predict byte exact for every cell
baselines.scored_on: the same new-stem cells as the predictor

statistics.mcnemar: exact two-sided: b = predictor correct and baseline wrong, c = predictor wrong and baseline correct, n = b + c, p = min(1, 2 * sum(C(n,k) for k in 0..min(b,c)) / 2**n); p = 1 when n = 0

branches_in_order: any new or replication cell lacks an object edge -> object_edge_unmeasurable
cpu or wall over cap -> budget_stop
type1 == 0 and type2 == 0 and both outcome classes present overall and in each family and accuracy > max(baselines) -> argmax_predicts_content
errors > 0 and accuracy > max(baselines) and mcnemar_p_vs_length_rule < alpha -> argmax_partial_predictor
classifier.note: branches are mutually exclusive and evaluated in this order; the contingency table and every error cell are reported

main_task_rule.argmax_predicts_content: the object-edge argmax is a usable predictor of content failure on these stems; it still does not relax the 192/192 shape limit
main_task_rule.argmax_partial_predictor: the predictor beats the length rule but makes errors; record the error cells and do not write a mechanism conclusion
main_task_rule.any_other_class: the R60 post-hoc separation is not supported as a predictor; the hypothesis is withdrawn

gates.structural_pass: 12 structural cells exact AND every cell field_lengths_ok
gates.object_edge_measured: every cell carries a trace at object_stop
gates.anchor_match: all replication cells equal R60's published rows on every declared field

definition.scope: dev/synthetic only; the sealed confirm split and its holdout report are not read; no change to 192/192; conclusions limited to these stems, place 6 B and this description pair
definition.estimate_rule: D-64: single run x 3 (one run plus two replay margins) + report assembly

unit_price_source.r61_single_run_derivation: 1.59 setup + 56 x 0.2433 = 15.21; declared 25 with margin for longer names
unit_price_source.caveat: D-69 logged a 2.0x mismatch between R59 and R60 unit prices; the cap, not the estimate, is the binding budget

immutability: written once before the run; never rewritten
